Le bureau relaie les événements importan: Your office reports key post-race events and team developments without repeating every moment of the live race.
Le manuel complet de Cyclo Stratège : ca: The complete Cyclo Stratège manual: calendar, racing, training, form, staff, transfers, finances, objectives and progression.
Le visage d’un coureur reste stable. Son: A rider's face stays the same. Their portrait automatically uses their new team's jersey after a transfer, or the active sponsor's jersey.
Les fiches des DS, équipes, nations et c: Other players can view Sporting Director, team, nation and rider profiles. Private contract and schedule information is visible only to the relevant Sporting Director.
Les objectifs primaires accompagnent l’i: Primary objectives guide your first steps: your Sporting Director profile, amateur team, first race entry, then hiring a staff member and signing a rider. Secondary objectives track wins, roster, equipment, staff, levels, jerseys, race participation and wildcards.
Les objectifs terminés ne versent leur r: Completed objectives pay out only when you click the claim button. Remember to claim your introductory rewards.
Top stage finishes earn prize money. On a tour, these prizes are accumulated and paid on the day of the final stage.
Les étapes s’enchaînent à raison d’une l: One stage takes place in the morning and another in the afternoon. A 10-stage tour therefore lasts five game days.
Ne remplissez pas le calendrier d’un lea: Do not fill a leader's calendar on day one. Check their schedule, form and the race profiles before each entry.
Ouvrez la fenêtre dédiée du live. Les gr: Open the dedicated live race window. Groups, incidents, weather, energy, attacks and commentary update as the race unfolds.
Protège uniquement les coureurs qui lui: Protects only assigned riders against form loss, especially after races.
Revenez dans ce guide à tout moment : il: Return to this guide at any time from the public website or the game header.
Réservez les fortes intensités aux pério: Use high intensity when there is no immediate race target, set a high enough rest threshold before a Grand Tour and match your best coaches to riders with the right specialities.
Si une perte devait faire passer la form: If form loss would take a rider below 0, form stays at 0 and an otherwise available rider receives a three-day fatigue injury. This rule never adds to an existing injury.
Un coureur qui abandonne reste dans le r: A rider who abandons remains at the bottom of the results marked DNF. On a tour, they do not start the next stage.
Un coureur très attardé ne récupère pas: A rider far behind cannot artificially erase a huge gap. They may benefit from a descent, but catching up always depends on their ability, energy and the pace of the groups.
Un objectif ne peut être validé qu’une f: Each objective can be completed only once. Open the completed objective and click Reward to receive its money, XP, reputation or item.
A classic costs 10 form points. On a tour, form loss per stage depends in part on recovery and ranges from 5 to 10 before protection bonuses.
• En CLM et en prologue, « S’économiser: • In time trials and prologues, Save energy reduces pace, energy use and form loss. Go all out improves the time but greatly increases those costs.
• En CLM par équipes, les relais doivent: • In team time trials, turn shares must add up to exactly 100%. They determine each rider's contribution to the team's pace.
• Le poids ne remplace jamais les notes: • Weight adjusts ratings only within set limits. It cannot turn a weak climber into a mountain leader.
• Les jeunes grandissent jusqu’à leur mo: • Juniors grow towards their adult build. Their projected height and weight remain visible at the Youth Development Centre.
• Perdre des équipiers réduit progressiv: • Losing teammates gradually reduces cohesion: even excellent isolated rouleurs cannot maintain the power of a full team.
L’assistant du DS vous avertit du surpoi: The Sporting Director's assistant flags overweight riders and distinguishes reduced bonuses from penalties. Each rider's threshold appears on their profile and in Nutrition. Dropping below the threshold clears the warning.
La réputation revient au Directeur Sport: Reputation belongs to the Sporting Director, XP raises their level, money funds the team and UCI points rank the rider, team and nation. Missing values count as zero.
Le prix rapporte une petite prime à l’éq: The award gives the team a small cash prize and the rider XP, but no reputation or UCI points. On a classic, the stage award is the race's combativity trophy. On a tour, the overall combativity award adds a further reward to the stage awards.
Les courses Continentales demandent 100: Continental races require 100 reputation points and World races require 200. Elite teams can enter Elite races directly; other divisions may request a wildcard with eight or nine riders. On D−1, the organiser ranks applications using team and main sponsor nationality, reputation, the best entered rider's suitability for the course and, from season 4, any reputation pledged to support the bid.
Lorsqu’un groupe en rejoint un autre, il: When one group catches another, they merge. Riders then share the same dynamics, gaps and revised team priorities; overlapping groups do not keep racing as separate groups.
L’inventaire regroupe le matériel acheté: Your inventory holds purchased equipment, special ability items, potential boosts and attribute boosts. Assign a consumable to the chosen rider to apply its effect.
Un changement reste possible jusqu’à cin: You can change the item until five minutes before the start. It is then locked for that race.
• Le leader et le coureur protégé sont a: • The team waits for its leader and protected rider. Other riders may stop taking turns before they actually lose contact.
• Un gabarit plus puissant est davantage: • A more powerful build helps on the flat and cobbles, and to a lesser extent in time trials and descents.
• Une équipe complète peut sacrifier jus: • A full team can sacrifice up to three riders, but the timed group always retains a core of at least four.

Améliore la séance du coureur auquel il: Improves the assigned rider's training: +4% per level in the coach's speciality, plus +10% if their nationalities match.
Chaque coureur peut posséder jusqu’à tro: Each rider can have up to three favourite races per season. Racing them grants +2 to all thirteen race ratings without changing permanent attributes, as well as a morale boost.
Chaque étape en ligne et chaque classiqu: Every road stage and classic rewards the most combative rider. Kilometres at the front, turns taken, attacks and gaps created all count. A tour also awards an overall combativity prize based on all stages.
En montagne, les coureurs trop faibles p: In the mountains, riders unable to follow the favourites try to form a grupetto to save energy and finish within the time limit. Exhausted riders can still be dropped from it and finish outside the limit.
Encadre toute l’école de cyclisme : +2 %: Oversees the entire cycling school: +2% per level in their speciality, +1% per level through affixes and +5% for juniors sharing their nationality. One per team.
Environ une offre sur trois peut comport: Around one offer in three may include a main objective: a specific result at a race important to the brand. Success pays a substantial immediate bonus; failure costs the reputation stated in the offer.
jours et coûte 50 000 € par niveau du bâ: days and costs €50,000 per building level. The previous specialisation stays active until the change takes effect.
jours et doit se terminer avant le dépar: days and must finish before the start. It targets a specific classic or stage and temporarily grants +
L’effectif junior se construit de J1 à J: Build your junior roster from D1 to D7; it locks on D8. Junior races are simulated without a live broadcast. Podium finishes improve riders according to their profile, favouring their lowest ratings.
L’entraîneur ajoute +4 % par niveau sur: The coach adds +4% per level to training gains in their speciality and +10% to the whole session when they share the rider's nationality. Both bonuses stack.
La page de résultat propose un rapport r: The results page has an expandable 20–30-line race report covering key breakaways, maximum gaps, group merges, late attacks, riders caught, mechanicals, crashes and victory.
Le bonus de satisfaction lié au renfort: The satisfaction bonus for strengthening your commitment is added to normal result-based gains, within the sponsor's overall cap.
Le diagnostic détermine la durée de base: The diagnosis sets the base injury duration and DNF risk. The doctor automatically shortens new injuries by 6% per level. Your chosen treatment then affects the stated duration or form loss.
Le moral va de 0 à 100 et débute à 60. I: Morale ranges from 0 to 100 and starts at 60. It affects race performance without changing permanent ratings or replacing form. Low morale hurts slightly more than very high morale helps.
Le préparateur de course améliore le bon: The course specialist improves the bonus by 5% per level. Their Negotiated Logistics specialisation can also reduce the cost by 4% per level.
Le tracé affine encore cet effet secteur: The route further adjusts this effect by sector: up to ±4.5 on a hard climb, −3 to +2.2 on cobbles, −2.2 to +2.2 on gravel, ±1.2 downhill and −4 to +1 on the flat. These are rating equivalents, not permanent attribute gains.
Leader absolu, co-leader, capitaine de r: Sole leader, co-leader, road captain, lieutenant, free role, stage hunter, prospect, domestique or bottle carrier: roster status helps organise and sort your squad. Race roles are chosen separately.
Les compléments nutritionnels rendent de: Nutritional supplements restore form but carry a small risk of weight gain, clearly shown before confirmation. A better nutritionist reduces that risk.
Les coureurs sans équipe suivent chaque: Free agents train independently each morning at moderate intensity, focusing on their strengths. Progress follows the usual potential, age and rating caps, without team coach or building bonuses. Injury or form below 50 prevents that day's progress; age-related decline still applies. Once signed, the team's schedule takes over without a second session.
Les fiches conservent les victoires, pod: Profiles retain wins, podiums, titles, classification jerseys, stage wins and development team seasons, even after a transfer or retirement.
Les niveaux cumulés des médecins amélior: The doctors' combined levels improve training camps by 5% per level, up to +50%. Bulk scheduling can never take a rider above 100 form.
Les prologues sont de très courts contre: Prologues are very short time trials at the start of some tours. From season 4, the calendar covers more countries, has more varied profiles and fewer team time trial finales.
Leur origine tient compte du pays de l’é: Offers take team country, rider nationalities and rider ability into account. Depending on its level, an international cycling school adds a 30–70% chance of at most one offer from its country in the annual batch. Multiple schools stack up to 85%, without bypassing reputation requirements.
Pilote une recherche gratuite à la fois: Runs one free R&D project at a time in the laboratory. Their talents shorten research time or improve success chances.
Sur une arrivée massive, les coureurs du: In a bunch finish, riders in the same group receive the same time, shown as ST. Outside a bunch sprint, a one-second separation creates a real time gap: the final effort can therefore spread out a hilly or mountain finish considerably.
Un coureur libre peut partir à la retrai: A free agent may retire after two full consecutive seasons without a team. Any season spent partly under contract does not count. Free agents who have scored UCI points are protected. Retired riders' profiles and honours remain available.
Un coureur protégé qui n’a pas les jambe: Protection cannot artificially keep a rider in a group they lack the legs to follow. The team may leave one helper to limit losses or join a grupetto, while the other domestiques refocus on the leader.
Un ingénieur disponible peut rechercher: An available engineer can research an unequipped item in a category unlocked by the laboratory. Research is free; the item is unavailable until completion. A prototype can be researched repeatedly without changing its name. Duration depends on its current total rating, the sum of bonuses and penalties: 2 days per point up to +6, then 4 days per additional point up to the +10 cap. A setback shortens the next project; an improvement lengthens it. Engineer talents reduce duration, with a minimum of one day. The Sporting Director's assistant flags available engineers and eligible items. Effects stack: research can improve an existing attribute or add a new one. The laboratory shows equipment, staff, success chances and before/after history. Gains appear in green and losses in red, with cumulative changes distinguished from the latest result.
Une équipe dispose de 35 places professi: A team has 35 professional roster slots. The Sports Management Centre adds five per level. Its Youth Pathway specialisation reserves another 3, 4, then 5 slots for club-trained riders.
Une équipe ne peut mener qu’une construc: A team can run only one construction project at a time. At the start, the chosen architect locks in the cost reduction, time reduction or balance between the two.
Une note prioritaire reçoit 100 % du gai: A primary attribute receives 100% of the base gain, a secondary attribute 55% and a maintenance attribute 10%. Age, potential, current rating, intensity, facilities and coaching then adjust that gain.
Une Régionale est réservée aux équipes a: Regional races are restricted to amateur teams from their continent. From season 4, each active country has four local classics and one mini-tour. Only teams from that country see them in their calendar and may enter, but everyone can view their pages and results.
Vous pouvez choisir Montagne, Vallons, P: Choose Mountains, Hills, Cobbles or Flat, or leave research unfocused. The focus does not change the success rate: 60% of draws target the group's primary attributes, 20% its secondary attributes and 20% other attributes. Mountains favours MO, then STA, RES, REC and DH; Hills favours HIL and ACC, then RES, STA and FTR; Cobbles favours COB and RES, then FL, STA and ACC; Flat favours FL, SP and TT, then ACC, STA and PRL. A setback can also affect the drawn attribute. The preview details staff talents, nationality or host-country affinity and Federal Institute bonuses. These bonuses and starting ratings are recorded when research begins to keep a reliable history.
